schema.description: A machine as `machine ls` and `ls` show it: its profile and its line now.

host.description: What that core calls itself (its hostname).

name.description: What this core calls it: `rohan` in `rohan/t7`.

session.description: The hc session there (null: its default).

since_ms.description: Since when it is not connected (ms since the epoch).

target.description: How it is reached: an ssh target, or (`via`) a command.

temporary.description:
Short-lived (a sandbox for a task): clients may show it apart from the
machines that stay. hc treats it like any other.

version.description: Its hc version when last seen.

via.description:
`target` is a command that runs a shell line there, given as its last
argument, like ssh (a provider's own CLI, ssh with its options).
